C x.di-interface-registration EX ARC-021,ARC-007 DEFAULT ;; Application services, repositories and external adapters use interface-to-implementation registration at boundaries; concrete registration for implementation-only helpers. ;; = ;; Implementation-only helpers. ;; Registration-shape rule not in the oracle.
C gov012.explicit-registration OL GOV-012,GOV-013 PREFER ;; Prefer explicit registration in small/medium applications; add scanning, keyed services, factories or decorators only for actual composition problems. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc023.layer-methods OL ARC-023 DEFAULT ;; Application exposes its own registration method, Infrastructure registers technical implementations, the API composes them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.di-technique-conditions EX GOV-012 DEFAULT ;; Keyed services only for key-selected implementations; decorators for cross-cutting wrapping; assembly scanning only for genuinely repetitive registration and over the owning assembly. ;; = ;; none ;; Optional DI technique (EXC-005).
C dep001.no-scrutor-for-one OL DEP-001,GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add Scrutor solely for one decoration when normal composition is simpler. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc022.scope-per-operation OL ARC-022,ARC-001 MUST ;; When a singleton/hosted service needs scoped work create a scope per operation and resolve a scoped orchestration service, not Infrastructure internals. ;; = ;; none ;;
